what: bcd-table.bin — the exhaustive ABCD/SBCD/NBCD expectation table the verifier's ROM embeds. The ROM passes on real hardware (Model 1 Sega Genesis, Model 3 VA2).
layout: 2 bytes per entry [flags, result]; flags = X<<4|N<<3|Z<<2|V<<1|C; ABCD 262144 entries at 0, SBCD 262144 at 524288, NBCD 1024 at 1048576; index ((src*256+dst)*4 + X*2 + Z)*2 (NBCD: ((dst*4 + X*2 + Z)*2) + 1048576)
